title: [MTR4] FlixTrain Siemens Vectron Locomtive + Eurofima Coaches
description: ResourcePack that adds a Siemens Vectron Locomotive and Eurofima Coaches with the FlixTrain branding for Minecraft Transit Railway.
body:
# Overview
![Vectron Locomitve pulling EUROFIMA Coaches](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6e9206099008eaa3e19ea920ec41357c7e9232a_0.webp)
FlixTrain is an open-access railway operator owned by Flix SE, providing affordable long-distance passenger rail services across Germany and other parts of Europe. Since its launch in 2018, the company has become one of the most recognizable private rail operators in Europe, distinguished by its bright green livery and low-cost business model.

The locomotives used by FlixTrain are primarily Siemens Vectron electric locomotives. Introduced in 2010 as part of Siemens Mobility's Vectron family, these locomotives are designed for interoperability across multiple European railway networks and can operate at speeds of up to 200 km/h. The Vectron platform has become one of the most successful modern locomotive designs in Europe, with over a thousand units delivered to operators throughout the continent.

FlixTrain services are commonly formed of refurbished EUROFIMA passenger coaches. Originally developed during the 1970s by the European Rolling Stock Company (EUROFIMA), these coaches were designed to standardize international passenger rolling stock across Europe. Many of the coaches currently used by FlixTrain have been modernized and repainted into the operator's distinctive green-and-white branding while retaining their proven EUROFIMA design.

## FlixTrain in Minecraft (MTR mod)

This resource pack adds FlixTrain to Minecraft using the Minecraft Transit Railway mod. The pack includes a Siemens Vectron electric locomotive in FlixTrain livery alongside a set of EUROFIMA coaches repainted to match FlixTrain's current passenger fleet.

The EUROFIMA coaches are based on models originally created by Soodari for the European Continental Trains pack. The textures have been completely reworked by Vitor2005 to accurately represent FlixTrain rolling stock. The Siemens Vectron locomotive is based on a freely available SketchUp model, available at: [https://embed-3dwarehouse-classic.sketchup.com/model/4e1214e1-e9e2-45a1-8ff7-dc85ba4c4668/Siemens-Vectron-Flixtrain](https://embed-3dwarehouse-classic.sketchup.com/model/4e1214e1-e9e2-45a1-8ff7-dc85ba4c4668/Siemens-Vectron-Flixtrain). The model has been adapted and optimized for use in Minecraft Transit Railway.

The pack is compatible with MTR4 only.

## Disclaimer
This resource pack is not associated with, and is not an official product of, FlixTrain, Flix SE, Siemens Mobility, EUROFIMA, SketchUp, the Minecraft Transit Railway mod, or Soodari.
